subject: PO acceptance and invoice mapping for consolidated billing
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@nimbushealth.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO requirements + invoice cadence (Nimbus Health)

Hi Markus / Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement at Nimbus is ready to move forward but we need to align on a few billing items before we can issue POs:  

- We operate with a single monthly consolidated invoice per legal entity. Can Redwood accept a single invoice that references multiple PO numbers (one PO per business unit)?
- If yes, we need the invoice to include a separate line-item mapping between invoice lines and PO numbers (or accept a separate CSV mapping file).
- Our standard net terms are Net45, but some of our larger divisions require Net60. Is Redwood able to support Net45/Net60 per PO or will terms need to be applied at the account level?
- Also confirm whether Redwood requires a single vendor code / supplier ID on the invoice, or if multiple supplier references can be accommodated by our ERP.

I attached our procurement spec that lists the ERP fields required. Can you confirm whether these are acceptable or propose a minimal mapping we can use?  

We'd like to close commercial terms this week if possible.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Jenkins
Procurement Lead, Nimbus Health
procurement@nimbushealth.com

Attachment: procurement_spec.pdf (PDF, 78 KB)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements + invoice cadence (Nimbus Health)

Hi Sarah — great to hear and thanks for the spec. Quick answers and proposed next steps below.

Summary answers:
- Single consolidated invoice: yes, we can accept one invoice that references multiple PO numbers.
- PO mapping: we prefer a line-item mapping on the invoice, but we can accept a separate CSV attachment (po-mapping-template.csv) alongside the invoice if that works for your ERP team.
- Net terms: default is account-level terms. We can make exceptions for enterprise customers to honor Net45 or Net60 on a per-PO basis, but that requires an approval from Finance and a contractual amendment that calls out the exception.
- Vendor code: we typically provide a single supplier ID on the invoice and include additional PO references in memo fields. If your ERP mandates separate supplier IDs per BU, we'll need the mapping file to reconcile.

Proposed action items:
1) Ben (CC) — can Finance sign off on per-PO term exceptions for HB-4892? We would like an approval path/criteria (commitment band, ARR threshold) so we can automate acceptance.
2) Sarah — can you confirm whether Nimbus can transmit the PO mapping as a CSV on the invoicing XML feed? If not, we will accept an attached CSV.
3) Vanessa/AE — we'll add a one-paragraph amendment to the SOW/MSA referencing "multiple PO references per invoice with attached PO mapping" to avoid ERP rejects. Sarah, would Procurement prefer a short amendment or an SOW exhibit?

If we get alignment on the three items above today, Vanessa and I can get a draft amendment over to you for signature.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements + invoice cadence (Nimbus Health)

Markus / team —

Finance notes and constraints:  
- We can approve per-PO Net45/Net60 exceptions for enterprise customers on a case-by-case basis. Approval criteria: minimum first-year committed spend of $250k and a signed amendment to the MSA documenting the exception.
- Operationally, the cleanest option is a single consolidated invoice with a CSV mapping file (PO Number, Invoice Line ID, BU Code). We have a template we use for ERP ingest (attached).
- If Nimbus cannot supply the CSV, we can accept line-level PO references on the invoice but may need to split for reconciliation depending on how your AP posts. Splitting increases processing effort and could delay payment.
- We cannot offer early-pay discounts at this time for the quoted commercial package.

I'll approve the Net45/Net60 per-PO exception for deal HB-4892 if Procurement confirms the monthly mapping file and the account reaches the $250k commit threshold. Once confirmed, we will add a clause to the SOW that states: "Redwood will accept consolidated invoices referencing multiple PO numbers provided that a machine-readable PO mapping file is delivered with each invoice; payment terms for each PO will be as specified in the signed amendment."

Attached: po-mapping-template.csv (CSV, 2 KB)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@nimbushealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements + invoice cadence (Nimbus Health)

Markus / Ben / Vanessa —

Thanks for the quick turn. Procurement confirms:  
- We will provide a monthly consolidated invoice with the PO mapping as a separate CSV attachment (format looks fine; we'll use your template).
- Nimbus can agree to the $250k first-year minimum spend as the criterion for per-PO term exceptions for this account.
- We would like the amendment to be a short SOW exhibit (one paragraph) that we can attach to the MSA. Procurement prefers Exhibit A-style language rather than changing core MSA terms.

Next steps: Vanessa — can your team draft the SOW exhibit (one paragraph) that references the CSV mapping and per-PO term exception? Once we have the exhibit we'll route internally for signature and return via DocuSign (please include the procurement email in the routing).

Markus — forwarding Ben's approval to our internal team. If you can attach the same wording in the SOW exhibit, procurement will expedite the DocuSign routing.

Appreciate the responsiveness — aiming to have POs issued by end of week once amendment is in place.

Regards,
Sarah Jenkins
Procurement Lead, Nimbus Health
procurement@nimbushealth.com
